If you're brand new to Motörhead and are looking into checking out more of their stuff, the search can be a little daunting. With over 20 studio albums released, not to mention all the live appearances and compilation albums, you may know know where to start.

If you have ever uttered to yourself the phrase: "Hey, Ace of Spades sounds cool, but what else do they have?" then you have come to the right place. I have carefully curated* this list of killer tracks to get your head-banging journey started. These tracks are divided up into what i consider to be the three big era's of the career of Lemmy and Co. They are:

1975 - 1982: Classic Era 1983 - 1995: Middle Era 1996 - 2015: Modern Era

I'll talk more about these eras at some point in the future**. I may even give each one their own post.

The whole goal of this is to provide a sampler of good starter tracks from each era which to my ears sound like a good mix. Excellent tracks and albums abound in each of these eras. It has been said before that there is no such thing as a bad Motörhead album, and while the quality can certainly fluctuate, Motörhead were a very consistent band, and almost all of their albums really stand the test of time (at least by my evaluation). So feel free to explore anywhere you want. Pick an album at random if you wish, or head on over to a video I highly recommend by Razörfist on YouTube for a short review on each album to get an idea of what you're in for. S without further ado, I present my playlist. Hope you enjoy.

// Classic Era: //

  1. Ace of Spades - Ace of Spades (1980)

  2. Stay Clean - Overkill (1979)

  3. Shut It Down - Iron Fist (1982)

  4. Metropolis - Overkill (1979)

  5. Love Me Like a Reptile (1980)

  6. Bomber - Bomber (1979)

// Middle Era //

  1. Doctor Rock - Orgasmatron (1986)

  2. Blackheart - Rock 'N' Roll (1987)

  3. Burner - Bastards (1993)

  4. Bad Religion - March ör Die (1992)

  5. Rock It - Another Perfect Day (1983)

  6. Bad Woman - Bastards (1993)

// Modern Era //

  1. Killers - Inferno (2004)

  2. See Me Burning - We Are Motörhead (2000)

  3. Lost Woman Blues - Aftershock (2013)

  4. Rock It - Motörizer (2008)

  5. When the Sky Comes Looking for You - Bad Magic (2015)

*"Careful curation" may or may not include sipping beer and going "that sounds good enough"
